source_key_points: 14 CHAPTER Economic Activities Around Us The root of prosperity is economic activity, the lack of it brings material distress.

What differentiates these activities to be grouped into sectors?

Activities that create monetary value: Value of something value are called economic activities.

To understand measured in terms of these activities better we will learn how economic activities money.
